allocator.description: allocates a new object and returns a pointer to it, or NULL on failure

duplicator.description: creates a duplicate of an object and returns a pointer to it, or NULL on failure

container_insert.description: transfers ownership of an object into a container or list; on success the container takes responsibility for freeing it

deallocator.description: frees an object or memory; the pointer must not be used afterwards

null_on_failure.description: may return NULL to indicate failure, so callers must check the result before use
